Subject: Engineer sandbox MAP — week0 onboarding & validation doc

Ari —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I drafted a focused "engineer sandbox" MAP intended to speed Spectra's Week 0: get infra access, run end-to-end inference with a small test corpus, and validate latency/cost assumptions. The doc prioritizes technical acceptance criteria the dev team requested (latency P95 targets, KV-cache behavior checks, and a small regression prompt set).

What I attached and linked:
- week0-sandbox-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with concrete tasks, owners, and estimated hours)
- map-template-engineer.md (plain-text MAP template with acceptance metrics and runbook)
- GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xq-sandbox-map-seed/edit (editable by Spectra)

Suggested Week 0 milestones (high level):
1) Access & credentials: get VPC peering + service account -> by Day 1
2) Baseline run: run 100 sample requests, capture latency tokens/cost -> Day 2
3) KV/priming test: verify prefix cache persistence for session-based flows -> Day 3
4) Ops dashboard check: confirm logs, tracing, and token-level cost visibility -> Day 4

I called out two quick risk items in the doc: (a) long-context models may require different kernel profiles; (b) if Spectra needs air-gapped, we'll swap to the Private deployment playbook. Both are noted with fallback options.

Ask: Can you share an engineer we should loop in for the Day 1 access steps? If you prefer, we can run the baseline ourselves and share results by end of Day 2.

Thanks — happy to iterate on the doc in real time if you open edit access.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer

All — quick notes after I reviewed the GDoc. I added a short tech validation section under "Acceptance Criteria" that maps to Redwood Console dashboards we can instrument during Week 0:
- Token-level cost by route (to validate unit economics)
- Inference P95/P99 latency for small (32 tokens) and medium (256 token) inputs
- KV cache hit rate and median cold-start cost

Also patching the MAP template with a small runbook for rollback if a model quantization profile causes regression (two-step: revert to previous quant profile -> re-run regression prompts -> notify stakeholders).

Karthik — can you add a couple of lines in the sheet assigning owners (Sam for VPC, Karthik for baseline run, Marissa for dashboard checks)? I added tentative times. I also uploaded a lightweight slide stub to the Drive link to use during the Day 1 sync.

Jasmine — FYI the acceptance criteria we want to show at the executive sync: baseline latency, cost per 1k tokens, and a short demo of model output parity on the regression set.
